---
title: "16S v2: current-experiment cycle models"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-fold: false
editor: source
execute:
  enabled: false
---

This notebook uses the 12-sample current-experiment ASV table to distinguish a persistent difference
between the two observed membranes (the adjusted main condition term) from a
condition difference that changes across cleaning cycles (the joint
condition-by-cycle interaction).

Analysis specification:

- One membrane per condition. Condition equals membrane identity; the six
  observations per condition are repeated temporal observations of one system,
  not biological replicates. No formula below supplies replication and no
  random membrane intercept is separately identifiable alongside condition.
  The residual-dependence assumption of every fit is therefore that the
  phase-by-cycle observations within a membrane are conditionally independent
  given the fixed effects. That assumption is stated, not tested.
- Counts are unrarefied cDNA-derived 16S ASV counts from the 150,000-pair
  subsampled v1 run (279/200, `pool = FALSE`). Nothing here is a full-depth
  rerun. Models are applied to counts, never to percentages.
- Statistical evidence (model tables) is kept separate from descriptive
  plotting values (CLR trajectories). Sensitivity analyses are labelled.

```sh
source config/16s_v2_paths.sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/run_16s_v2_cycle_models.qmd [input_dir] [output_dir] [sample_metadata]
```

`input_dir` holds the read-only copy of the accepted v1 return
(`16s_asv_counts_unrarefied.tsv`, `16s_asv_taxonomy_silva138.2.tsv`,
`16s_sample_data.tsv`). Automatic execution during rendering is disabled
because this workflow writes project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: run-16s-v2-cycle-models
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
v2_inputs <- Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_V2_INPUTS")
input_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else if (nzchar(v2_inputs)) file.path(v2_inputs, "v1_return_2026-09-03") else ""
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_V2_CYCLE_MODEL_DIR")
metadata_path <- if (length(args) >= 3L) args[[3L]] else "metadata/sample_metadata.tsv"
if (!nzchar(input_dir) || !nzchar(output_dir)) {
  abort("Provide input_dir and output_dir, or source config/16s_v2_paths.sh first.")
}
for (pkg in c("DESeq2", "edgeR", "ggplot2")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) abort("Package %s is required.", pkg)
}
# Isolation guard: refuse to write into any protected v1 location.
protected <- c("derived/16s_analysis", "derived/16s_manuscript_integration",
               "phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569", "OneDrive-nium.io")
for (p in protected) if (grepl(p, output_dir, fixed = TRUE)) abort("output_dir resolves into protected location %s", p)
set.seed(20260901L)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
notebook <- Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH", unset = "")
repo_root <- if (nzchar(notebook)) dirname(dirname(notebook)) else getwd()
source(file.path(repo_root, "R", "figure_style.R"))

read_tsv <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) abort("Missing input %s", path)
  read.delim(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, quote = "", comment.char = "",
             check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
write_tsv <- function(x, name) {
  write.table(x, file.path(output_dir, name), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
              row.names = FALSE, na = "")
}
md5 <- function(path) unname(tools::md5sum(path))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- inputs
input_files <- c(
  counts = file.path(input_dir, "16s_asv_counts_unrarefied.tsv"),
  taxonomy = file.path(input_dir, "16s_asv_taxonomy_silva138.2.tsv"),
  sample_data = file.path(input_dir, "16s_sample_data.tsv"),
  dada2_parameters = file.path(input_dir, "16s_dada2_parameters.tsv"),
  sample_metadata = metadata_path
)
counts_wide <- read_tsv(input_files[["counts"]])
taxonomy <- read_tsv(input_files[["taxonomy"]])
sample_data <- read_tsv(input_files[["sample_data"]])
metadata <- read_tsv(input_files[["sample_metadata"]])
dada2_parameters <- read_tsv(input_files[["dada2_parameters"]])

counts <- as.matrix(counts_wide[, -1L, drop = FALSE])
rownames(counts) <- counts_wide[[1L]]
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"
if (any(is.na(counts)) || any(counts < 0L)) abort("Counts must be non-negative integers.")

# The repository sample contract is metadata/sample_metadata.tsv. The return's
# sample data must agree with it on every design column before any model runs.
key_cols <- c("sample_title", "condition", "phase", "cycle", "amplicon_run_accession")
metadata <- metadata[order(metadata$condition, metadata$cycle, metadata$phase), ]
if (!setequal(metadata$sample_title, colnames(counts))) abort("Count columns and sample metadata disagree.")
if (!setequal(metadata$sample_title, sample_data$sample_title)) abort("Return sample data and sample metadata disagree.")
compare <- merge(metadata[, key_cols], sample_data[, key_cols], by = "sample_title", suffixes = c("_metadata", "_return"))
for (k in setdiff(key_cols, "sample_title")) {
  if (!identical(as.character(compare[[paste0(k, "_metadata")]]), as.character(compare[[paste0(k, "_return")]]))) {
    abort("Column %s differs between the return sample data and metadata/sample_metadata.tsv", k)
  }
}
counts <- counts[, metadata$sample_title, drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(metadata) != 12L) abort("Expected 12 physical samples, found %d", nrow(metadata))
cells <- table(metadata$condition, metadata$phase, metadata$cycle)
if (any(cells != 1L)) abort("Expected exactly one sample per condition x phase x cycle cell.")

# Set the reference levels for condition and sampling phase.
metadata$condition <- factor(metadata$condition, levels = c("control", "treatment"))
metadata$phase <- factor(metadata$phase, levels = c("initial", "backflush"))
metadata$cycle <- factor(as.character(metadata$cycle), levels = c("1", "2", "3"))
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample_title

formulas <- list(
  main = ~ phase + cycle + condition,
  full = ~ phase + cycle * condition,
  reduced = ~ phase + cycle + condition
)
designs <- lapply(formulas, function(f) model.matrix(f, data = metadata))
design_audit <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(designs), function(nm) {
  X <- designs[[nm]]
  data.frame(model = nm, formula = deparse(formulas[[nm]]), n_samples = nrow(X),
             n_coefficients = ncol(X), rank = qr(X)$rank, residual_df = nrow(X) - qr(X)$rank,
             coefficients = paste(colnames(X), collapse = ";"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
if (any(design_audit$rank != design_audit$n_coefficients)) abort("A design matrix is rank deficient.")
write_tsv(design_audit, "16s_v2_design_audit.tsv")
for (nm in names(designs)) {
  X <- designs[[nm]]
  write_tsv(data.frame(sample_title = rownames(X), X, check.names = FALSE), sprintf("16s_v2_design_matrix_%s.tsv", nm))
}
write_tsv(data.frame(sample_order = seq_len(nrow(metadata)),
                     metadata[, c("sample_title", "condition", "phase", "cycle", "amplicon_run_accession")]),
          "16s_v2_sample_order.tsv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- features
# Two ranks are tested. ASV is the native feature. Family is the highest rank at
# which more than half of ASVs (1,445 of 2,700) carry a SILVA assignment; genus
# is unassigned for 72% of ASVs and is not a defensible aggregation rank here.
# ASVs unassigned at family are NOT merged into one fictitious taxon: each stays
# its own feature, labelled by its ASV id, so the family table mixes true family
# sums with singleton unassigned ASVs. The feature-to-taxonomy map records this.
taxonomy <- taxonomy[match(rownames(counts), taxonomy$asv_id), ]
rank_cols <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
family_key <- ifelse(is.na(taxonomy$Family) | taxonomy$Family == "",
                     paste0("unassigned_at_family|", taxonomy$asv_id), taxonomy$Family)
family_counts <- rowsum(counts, group = family_key)
storage.mode(family_counts) <- "integer"

feature_sets <- list(asv = counts, family = family_counts)
feature_map <- rbind(
  data.frame(rank = "asv", feature_id = taxonomy$asv_id, member_asvs = taxonomy$asv_id,
             n_member_asvs = 1L, taxonomy[, rank_cols], stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(taxonomy, family_key), function(t) {
    fam_unassigned <- is.na(t$Family[[1L]]) || t$Family[[1L]] == ""
    lineage <- if (fam_unassigned) {
      t[1L, rank_cols]
    } else {
      # Lineage above family: report a value only where every member agrees.
      as.data.frame(lapply(rank_cols, function(r) {
        v <- unique(t[[r]][!is.na(t[[r]]) & t[[r]] != ""])
        if (r %in% c("Genus", "Species")) "" else if (length(v) == 1L) v else if (length(v) > 1L) "ambiguous" else ""
      }), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = rank_cols)
    }
    data.frame(rank = "family", feature_id = family_key[match(t$asv_id[[1L]], taxonomy$asv_id)],
               member_asvs = paste(t$asv_id, collapse = ";"), n_member_asvs = nrow(t),
               lineage, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
)
rownames(feature_map) <- NULL
write_tsv(feature_map, "16s_v2_feature_taxonomy_map.tsv")

# Declared count/prevalence filter, identical for both ranks and identical to
# the manuscript stream's MAG/vOTU DESeq2 filter: at least 10 counts in at
# least 3 of the 12 samples. No feature is preselected by prior significance.
min_count <- 10L
min_samples <- 3L
filter_report <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(feature_sets), function(rk) {
  m <- feature_sets[[rk]]
  keep <- rowSums(m >= min_count) >= min_samples
  data.frame(rank = rk, features_before = nrow(m), features_after = sum(keep),
             reads_before = sum(m), reads_after = sum(m[keep, , drop = FALSE]),
             fraction_reads_retained = round(sum(m[keep, , drop = FALSE]) / sum(m), 4),
             filter = sprintf("rowSums(counts >= %d) >= %d", min_count, min_samples),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
write_tsv(filter_report, "16s_v2_filter_report.tsv")
filtered_sets <- lapply(feature_sets, function(m) m[rowSums(m >= min_count) >= min_samples, , drop = FALSE])

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ DESeq2
# Normalisation: DESeq2 median-of-ratios with sfType = "poscounts". The default
# estimator needs every feature to be non-zero in every sample, which no sparse
# amplicon table satisfies; poscounts uses the geometric mean over positive
# counts instead. Dispersion: parametric trend, falling back to local if the
# parametric fit fails (recorded). Outliers: Cook's replacement is impossible
# (DESeq2 requires seven replicates per cell) and Cook's flagging requires three
# replicates per cell, which the full design (two observations per
# condition x cycle cell) does not provide; p-values are therefore never set
# to NA by Cook's distance in the full model. Independent filtering is DESeq2's
# default and is recorded in the metadata of every results object.
library(DESeq2)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(edgeR))

fit_deseq <- function(m, formula) {
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = m, colData = metadata, design = formula)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds, type = "poscounts")
  fit_type <- "parametric"
  dds <- tryCatch(estimateDispersions(dds, fitType = "parametric", quiet = TRUE),
                  error = function(e) { fit_type <<- "local"; estimateDispersions(dds, fitType = "local", quiet = TRUE) })
  list(dds = dds, fit_type = fit_type)
}

results_table <- function(res, rank, model, test, coefficient) {
  df <- as.data.frame(res)
  data.frame(rank = rank, model = model, test = test, coefficient = coefficient,
             feature_id = rownames(df), df, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

deseq_results <- list()
deseq_diagnostics <- list()
dds_objects <- list()
for (rk in names(filtered_sets)) {
  m <- filtered_sets[[rk]]

  # Main: adjusted common condition difference (Wald on the condition coefficient).
  main <- fit_deseq(m, formulas$main)
  dds_main <- nbinomWaldTest(main$dds)
  res_main <- results(dds_main, name = "condition_treatment_vs_control", alpha = 0.05)
  deseq_results[[paste(rk, "main")]] <- results_table(res_main, rk, "main", "wald", "condition_treatment_vs_control")

  # Full versus reduced: joint 2-df LRT for the two condition-by-cycle terms.
  # The log2FoldChange column that DESeq2 attaches to an LRT result is the last
  # coefficient of the full model (cycle3.conditiontreatment); it is NOT the
  # interaction effect and is removed from the LRT table to prevent that reading.
  full <- fit_deseq(m, formulas$full)
  dds_lrt <- nbinomLRT(full$dds, full = designs$full, reduced = designs$reduced)
  res_lrt <- results(dds_lrt, alpha = 0.05)
  lrt_table <- results_table(res_lrt, rk, "full_vs_reduced", "lrt_2df", "cycle2:conditiontreatment;cycle3:conditiontreatment")
  lrt_table$log2FoldChange <- NULL
  lrt_table$lfcSE <- NULL
  deseq_results[[paste(rk, "lrt")]] <- lrt_table

  # Named coefficients from the full model, each a Wald test, each labelled.
  # These are the cycle-1 condition contrast and the two changes in that
  # contrast at cycles 2 and 3; they are not omnibus trajectory tests.
  dds_full_wald <- nbinomWaldTest(full$dds)
  for (coef_name in c("condition_treatment_vs_control", "cycle2.conditiontreatment", "cycle3.conditiontreatment")) {
    label <- switch(coef_name,
      condition_treatment_vs_control = "condition_at_cycle1",
      cycle2.conditiontreatment = "interaction_cycle2_vs_cycle1",
      cycle3.conditiontreatment = "interaction_cycle3_vs_cycle1")
    res_c <- results(dds_full_wald, name = coef_name, alpha = 0.05)
    deseq_results[[paste(rk, label)]] <- results_table(res_c, rk, "full", "wald_coefficient", label)
  }

  dds_objects[[rk]] <- list(main = dds_main, lrt = dds_lrt, full_wald = dds_full_wald)
  for (fit_name in c("main", "lrt", "full_wald")) {
    d <- dds_objects[[rk]][[fit_name]]
    mc <- mcols(d)
    deseq_diagnostics[[paste(rk, fit_name)]] <- data.frame(
      rank = rk, fit = fit_name,
      formula = deparse(design(d)),
      dispersion_fit_type = if (fit_name == "main") main$fit_type else full$fit_type,
      size_factor_type = "poscounts",
      size_factor_min = round(min(sizeFactors(d)), 4), size_factor_max = round(max(sizeFactors(d)), 4),
      n_features = nrow(d),
      n_not_converged = if ("betaConv" %in% colnames(mc)) sum(!mc$betaConv, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_,
      n_dispersion_outliers = if ("dispOutlier" %in% colnames(mc)) sum(mc$dispOutlier, na.rm = TRUE) else sum(mcols(if (fit_name == "main") main$dds else full$dds)$dispOutlier, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_dispersion = round(median(dispersions(d), na.rm = TRUE), 4),
      max_cooks = if (!is.null(assays(d)[["cooks"]])) round(max(assays(d)[["cooks"]], na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA_real_,
      cooks_outlier_filtering = "not applied: fewer than 3 replicates per cell in the full design; DESeq2 does not flag",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}
# Keep a single column set so the tables bind: add empty effect columns to the LRT rows.
deseq_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(deseq_results, function(x) {
  for (col in c("log2FoldChange", "lfcSE")) if (!col %in% colnames(x)) x[[col]] <- NA_real_
  x[, c("rank", "model", "test", "coefficient", "feature_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]
}))
rownames(deseq_all) <- NULL
# BH families: DESeq2's padj is already BH within each (rank, model, coefficient)
# results call, i.e. within each declared feature family. Record the family
# size explicitly so a reader can audit it.
family_sizes <- aggregate(feature_id ~ rank + model + coefficient, deseq_all, length)
names(family_sizes)[4L] <- "bh_family_size_tested"
deseq_all <- merge(deseq_all, family_sizes, by = c("rank", "model", "coefficient"), sort = FALSE)
deseq_all$supported_fdr05 <- !is.na(deseq_all$padj) & deseq_all$padj < 0.05
# Zero handling is not a filter: a feature absent from both phases of a
# condition x cycle cell is legitimately tested, but an interaction driven by
# an all-zero cell rests on a log-scale contrast against zero. The count of
# such cells (out of six) travels with every result row so readers can see it.
zero_cells <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(filtered_sets), function(rk) {
  m <- filtered_sets[[rk]]
  cell <- paste(metadata$condition, metadata$cycle)
  cell_sums <- t(rowsum(t(m), group = cell))
  data.frame(rank = rk, feature_id = rownames(m),
             n_all_zero_condition_cycle_cells = rowSums(cell_sums == 0L),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
deseq_all <- merge(deseq_all, zero_cells, by = c("rank", "feature_id"), sort = FALSE)
deseq_all <- merge(deseq_all, feature_map[, c("rank", "feature_id", rank_cols)], by = c("rank", "feature_id"), sort = FALSE)
deseq_all <- deseq_all[order(deseq_all$rank, deseq_all$model, deseq_all$coefficient, deseq_all$padj, deseq_all$pvalue, na.last = TRUE), ]
write_tsv(deseq_all, "16s_v2_deseq2_results_all_features.tsv")
write_tsv(do.call(rbind, deseq_diagnostics), "16s_v2_deseq2_diagnostics.tsv")

# ----------------------------------------------------- edgeR QL sensitivity
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS. The transcriptome layer used edgeR quasi-likelihood
# models with the same two formulas; running them here shows whether the 16S
# conclusion depends on the DESeq2 machinery. TMMwsp normalisation is used
# because plain TMM is unstable on zero-heavy amplicon tables.
edger_results <- list()
edger_diagnostics <- list()
for (rk in names(filtered_sets)) {
  y <- DGEList(filtered_sets[[rk]], samples = metadata)
  y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMMwsp")
  y_main <- estimateDisp(y, designs$main, robust = TRUE)
  fit_main <- glmQLFit(y_main, designs$main, robust = TRUE)
  qlf_main <- glmQLFTest(fit_main, coef = "conditiontreatment")
  y_full <- estimateDisp(y, designs$full, robust = TRUE)
  fit_full <- glmQLFit(y_full, designs$full, robust = TRUE)
  interaction_cols <- grep(":", colnames(designs$full), fixed = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  qlf_int <- glmQLFTest(fit_full, coef = interaction_cols)
  as_table <- function(qlf, model, test, coefficient) {
    tt <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf, sort.by = "none")$table
    df <- data.frame(rank = rk, model = model, test = test, coefficient = coefficient,
                     feature_id = rownames(tt), tt, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$supported_fdr05 <- !is.na(df$FDR) & df$FDR < 0.05
    df
  }
  main_tab <- as_table(qlf_main, "main", "edgeR_QL_F", "conditiontreatment")
  int_tab <- as_table(qlf_int, "full", "edgeR_QL_F_2df", paste(interaction_cols, collapse = ";"))
  # The joint test's per-coefficient logFC columns are descriptive, not the test statistic.
  edger_results[[rk]] <- rbind(
    main_tab[, c("rank", "model", "test", "coefficient", "feature_id", "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR", "supported_fdr05")],
    within(int_tab, { logFC <- NA_real_ })[, c("rank", "model", "test", "coefficient", "feature_id", "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR", "supported_fdr05")]
  )
  edger_diagnostics[[rk]] <- data.frame(
    rank = rk, normalisation = "TMMwsp", n_features = nrow(y),
    common_dispersion_main = round(y_main$common.dispersion, 4),
    common_dispersion_full = round(y_full$common.dispersion, 4),
    prior_df_main = round(median(fit_main$df.prior), 2), prior_df_full = round(median(fit_full$df.prior), 2),
    residual_df_main = design_audit$residual_df[design_audit$model == "main"],
    residual_df_full = design_audit$residual_df[design_audit$model == "full"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
edger_all <- do.call(rbind, edger_results)
edger_all <- merge(edger_all, zero_cells, by = c("rank", "feature_id"), sort = FALSE)
edger_all <- merge(edger_all, feature_map[, c("rank", "feature_id", rank_cols)], by = c("rank", "feature_id"), sort = FALSE)
rownames(edger_all) <- NULL
write_tsv(edger_all, "16s_v2_sensitivity_edger_ql_results_all_features.tsv")
write_tsv(do.call(rbind, edger_diagnostics), "16s_v2_sensitivity_edger_ql_diagnostics.tsv")

# ------------------------------------------------ descriptive CLR trajectories
# Plotting values, not evidence. CLR on the full (unfiltered) table per rank
# with a pseudocount of 0.5 on every feature, then the treatment - control
# difference within each cycle x phase cell for the tested features.
clr_of <- function(m) {
  lg <- log2(m + 0.5)
  sweep(lg, 2L, colMeans(lg), "-")
}
trajectories <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(feature_sets), function(rk) {
  clr <- clr_of(feature_sets[[rk]])[rownames(filtered_sets[[rk]]), , drop = FALSE]
  long <- data.frame(
    rank = rk,
    feature_id = rep(rownames(clr), times = ncol(clr)),
    sample_title = rep(colnames(clr), each = nrow(clr)),
    clr = as.vector(clr), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  long <- cbind(long, metadata[long$sample_title, c("condition", "phase", "cycle")])
  rownames(long) <- NULL
  long
}))
write_tsv(trajectories, "16s_v2_clr_trajectories_long.tsv")
clr_differences <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(trajectories, trajectories[, c("rank", "feature_id", "cycle", "phase")], drop = TRUE), function(d) {
  data.frame(rank = d$rank[[1L]], feature_id = d$feature_id[[1L]], cycle = d$cycle[[1L]], phase = d$phase[[1L]],
             clr_treatment_minus_control = d$clr[d$condition == "treatment"] - d$clr[d$condition == "control"],
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
rownames(clr_differences) <- NULL
write_tsv(clr_differences, "16s_v2_clr_condition_differences_by_cell.tsv")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- summary
lrt_rows <- deseq_all[deseq_all$model == "full_vs_reduced", ]
main_rows <- deseq_all[deseq_all$model == "main", ]
classify <- function(rk) {
  m <- main_rows[main_rows$rank == rk, ]
  l <- lrt_rows[lrt_rows$rank == rk, ]
  both <- merge(m[, c("feature_id", "padj")], l[, c("feature_id", "padj")], by = "feature_id", suffixes = c("_main", "_lrt"))
  data.frame(
    rank = rk,
    features_tested = nrow(both),
    condition_associated_fdr05 = sum(both$padj_main < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    trajectory_associated_fdr05 = sum(both$padj_lrt < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    both_fdr05 = sum(both$padj_main < 0.05 & both$padj_lrt < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    edger_condition_fdr05 = sum(edger_all$supported_fdr05[edger_all$rank == rk & edger_all$model == "main"]),
    edger_interaction_fdr05 = sum(edger_all$supported_fdr05[edger_all$rank == rk & edger_all$model == "full"]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
summary_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(filtered_sets), classify))
write_tsv(summary_table, "16s_v2_cycle_model_summary.tsv")

# ------------------------------------------------------ candidate trajectories
# Unnumbered candidate figures: the features with the smallest LRT p-values and
# the smallest main-test p-values, at each rank, as CLR against cycle. Colour is
# condition (membrane), shape is phase; one line per membrane and phase.
library(ggplot2)
plot_features <- function(rk, ids, title, file) {
  d <- trajectories[trajectories$rank == rk & trajectories$feature_id %in% ids, ]
  d$feature_id <- factor(d$feature_id, levels = ids)
  d$condition_label <- phage_uv_normalise_condition(as.character(d$condition))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = cycle, y = clr, colour = condition_label, shape = phase,
                     group = interaction(condition_label, phase), linetype = phase)) +
    geom_line() + geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ feature_id, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = phage_uv_condition_colours, name = "Membrane") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = phage_uv_phase_shapes, name = "Phase") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(initial = "solid", backflush = "22"), name = "Phase") +
    labs(x = "Cleaning cycle", y = "CLR abundance (log2, pseudocount 0.5)", title = title,
         caption = "Descriptive plotting values. One membrane per condition; not replicated treatment effects.") +
    theme_phage_uv()
  n_rows <- ceiling(length(ids) / 3)
  grDevices::pdf(file.path(output_dir, file), width = 7.2, height = 1.2 + 1.9 * n_rows, useDingbats = FALSE)
  print(p)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}
figure_registry <- list()
for (rk in names(filtered_sets)) {
  top_lrt <- head(lrt_rows$feature_id[lrt_rows$rank == rk][order(lrt_rows$pvalue[lrt_rows$rank == rk])], 9L)
  top_main <- head(main_rows$feature_id[main_rows$rank == rk][order(main_rows$pvalue[main_rows$rank == rk])], 9L)
  f1 <- sprintf("16s-v2-trajectories-%s-top-interaction.pdf", rk)
  f2 <- sprintf("16s-v2-trajectories-%s-top-condition.pdf", rk)
  plot_features(rk, top_lrt, sprintf("%s features with smallest condition x cycle LRT p (unadjusted ranking)", rk), f1)
  plot_features(rk, top_main, sprintf("%s features with smallest adjusted condition p (unadjusted ranking)", rk), f2)
  figure_registry[[rk]] <- data.frame(
    file = c(f1, f2), rank = rk, ranking = c("deseq2 lrt_2df pvalue", "deseq2 main wald pvalue"),
    features = c(paste(top_lrt, collapse = ";"), paste(top_main, collapse = ";")),
    status = "unnumbered candidate; selection by p-value ranking, not by FDR support",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
write_tsv(do.call(rbind, figure_registry), "16s_v2_candidate_figure_registry.tsv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- provenance
pkg_versions <- data.frame(
  component = c("R", "DESeq2", "edgeR", "ggplot2"),
  version = c(paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
              as.character(packageVersion("DESeq2")), as.character(packageVersion("edgeR")),
              as.character(packageVersion("ggplot2"))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write_tsv(pkg_versions, "16s_v2_cycle_model_software_provenance.tsv")
write_tsv(rbind(
  data.frame(role = "input", file = input_files, md5 = vapply(input_files, md5, ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(role = "processing_parameter", file = paste0("v1:", dada2_parameters$parameter), md5 = dada2_parameters$value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
), "16s_v2_cycle_model_input_checksums.tsv")
outputs <- setdiff(list.files(output_dir), "16s_v2_cycle_model_output_checksums.tsv")
write_tsv(data.frame(file = outputs, bytes = file.size(file.path(output_dir, outputs)),
                     md5 = vapply(file.path(output_dir, outputs), md5, ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
          "16s_v2_cycle_model_output_checksums.tsv")
print(design_audit[, c("model", "formula", "rank", "residual_df")])
print(filter_report[, c("rank", "features_before", "features_after", "fraction_reads_retained")])
print(summary_table)
```
